findings.location: Paragraph containing Jesus' restoration exchange with Peter (around "Peter svarte... Jesus sa: 'Gjør mine lam til del.'")
findings.source_quote: “Peter answered, ‘Yes Lord, you know that I love you.’ Jesus said, ‘Feed my lambs.’”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the imperative accurately. Replace «Gjør mine lam til del.» with a natural Bokmål imperative equivalent such as «Fôr mine lam.» or «Mat mine lam.» (and keep same HTML structure and tags).
findings.translation_quote: «Peter svarte: ‘Ja Herre, du vet at jeg elsker deg.’ Jesus sa: ‘Gjør mine lam til del.’»

findings.location: Later restoration sentence (Jesus to Peter about sheep)
findings.source_quote: “Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee”. Jesus said to him: “Feed my sheep”.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the imperative accurately. Replace «Gjør mine sauer til del.» with a natural Bokmål imperative equivalent such as «Fôr mine sauer.» or «Mat mine sauer.» (preserve tags and surrounding punctuation).
findings.translation_quote: «Herre, du vet alt; du vet at jeg elsker deg.» Jesus sier til ham: «Gjør mine sauer til del.»

findings.location: Paragraph: “There is a purity and beauty…” (word form)
findings.source_quote: “There is a purity and beauty in the life of Jesus that resonates with those heart longings.”
findings.suggested_fix: Correct Bokmål spelling. Replace «hjertelængslene» with «hjertelengslene» or the more common Bokmål «hjertets lengsler» or «hjertets lengsler» depending on house style. Keep tags and punctuation unchanged.
findings.translation_quote: «Det er en renhet og skjønnhet i Jesu liv som resonnerer med disse hjertelængslene.»

findings.location: Paragraph about Zebedee and sons (word form)
findings.source_quote: “Perhaps he was hoping that time with the Nazarene would soften the temper of their abrasive characters.”
findings.translation_quote: «Kanskje håpet han at tid med Nasarenen ville mildne temperementet i deres skarpe væremåte.»

findings.suggested_fix: Use standard Bokmål formation for the section title. Replace «Den nye testamentlige kirke» with «Den nytestamentlige kirke». (This is a stylistic/idiomatic correction; preserve capitalization and tag placement.)
